author: Binx, clock face from inerthel-agi
name: Binxbar
description: Desk control panel for the Xeneon Edge: mic live/mute, Discord call status, wrong-mic fix, voice-channel bubbles with tap-to-join, stream and disconnect buttons, music and volume, brightness, clock, calendar, a weather station with radar, and phone calls through Phone Link (alerts, answer/decline, a dial pad and your contacts).
